title: Decoding Compressed Trust: Scrutinizing the Trustworthiness of Efficient LLMs Under Compression

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the correlation between model predictions and sensitive attributes (gender and sex) using demographic parity difference (DPD) and equalized odds difference (EOD) metrics across zero-shot and few-shot scenarios with varying base rate parity.

Prompting the model with benign, untargeted, and targeted instructions containing biased statements (e.g., about immigrants) and measuring the rate at which the model agrees with or rejects these biased points of view.
